subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require live Telegram/gateway proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept source-level proof for the owner-session delivery routing change?
rationale: The patch changes session/message-delivery routing for a Telegram-visible path, and the contributor has not supplied the live proof the PR body itself says is pending.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing background-task completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gap and own the risk that real transport/session delivery still drops or misroutes the completion.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the fix folded into a wider detached-subagent liveness and terminal-notification design.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing background-task completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current-line and recent-history signal across the task, heartbeat, and subagent completion paths touched by the PR.
